title: pkg/domain/entities: remove unreachable "pod" ps sort option
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

`SortPsOutput` had a `case "pod"` (backed by a `psSortedPod` sorter), but it is onlyever called from the `podman ps` CLI *after* the `--sort` value is validated by `validate.Value` from [ps.go](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/d092919e557a53b819bacbe7a40e2b26f300044a/cmd/podman/containers/ps.go#L104) , whose allowed set does not include `pod`. So the sort key can never be `pod` and the case is unreachable dead code. Every user-facing surface consistently excludes `pod` too — validation + flag help, shell completion (`AutocompletePsSort`), the invalid-option error message, and the man page. This removes the unreachable case and its sorter.
